name: Nisuke Ajima
source:
Nisuke is defined by emotional reliance on others, often having trouble conveying his emotions without another person to pull from. He’s a natural creative, using puzzles and home movies to express himself when words fail him, often salvaged from unsold inventory of his family’s thrift store. Raised in a religious home, Nisuke has always had pressure upon him to live virtuously and put others before himself, leading to claims of idolatry when his films began attracting widespread attention.
